'''Choir''' is a blueprint that can be build in the [[Church]]. It can only be built once and has a fixed position to the right of the altar. Once selected, it is built and the blueprint disappears.

The Choir provides {{Icon|Church Quality|+1}}, and each [[zombie]] assigned to it provides {{Icon|Church Quality|+1}}. Zombies can have certain perks in the {{Mastery|Blue}} tree that further increase {{Icon|Church Quality}} (the values do not stack; they replace each other):

* {{Item|Novice Musician}}: {{Icon|Church Quality|+2}}
* {{Item|Skilled Musician}}: {{Icon|Church Quality|+4}}
* {{Item|Maestro}}: {{Icon|Church Quality|+7}}

Having a functional Choir is required to progress through the [[quest]] "[[The Nun Also Reads]]".
